paragraphs: Metropolis runs parking, and describes itself as the largest parking operator in the U.S. Its computer vision technology powers checkout-free drive-in, drive-out parking. The company calls the drivers who use its locations Members.
It says it has built an intelligence layer for physical infrastructure. The stated goal is access that works without tapping, scanning or using an app, because presence alone is enough.

Metropolis launched its first location at a commercial garage in Venice, CA. It then raised a $41M Series A and expanded to New York, San Francisco, Nashville, Austin and Seattle. A later round of $1.8B accompanied the acquisition of SP Plus Corporation. The company also reports securing $1.6B in financing. Its news list points to a partnership with Joby to develop 25 vertiport sites across the U.S. It states that it is a TIME100 Most Influential Company of 2026.

quote.text: Metropolis has built an intelligence layer for physical infrastructure.
